annotations.title: Copy images from BusinessCloud into MediaStudio

description: Copy images from the user's BusinessCloud into MediaStudio — 'take the photos from my folder summer party'. The files stay in the cloud. In MediaStudio they are PUBLICLY reachable afterwards: tell the user and ask before calling this. Images only (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF); paths come from list_cloud_files.

paths.description: File paths as list_cloud_files returns them (up to 25).

name: import_cloud_files
title: Copy images from BusinessCloud into MediaStudio
